title: Balancing Adaptability and Non-exploitability in Repeated Games
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct any benchmarks related to faith or religion. The benchmarks measure algorithm performance in repeated games based on regret and non-exploitability.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it focuses on game theory and multi-agent reinforcement learning.
